amendments.because: The owner chose all three balance rules on 31 Oct 2026: free the place, finish before start, pause new builds when the test line is long
amendments.done_when: While a builder's tests wait in the test line, the machine's agent line shows that place as free and another waiting item starts; when the builder's tests finish, it waits for an agent place again before its round goes on.

done_when: While a builder's tests wait in the test line, its agent place is free for another item and it waits for a place again before its round goes on; a free agent place goes first to work near the end (a fix round after a failed test, a review) and a new build last; and no new build starts while more than 2 items wait for the test place, starting again when 1 waits
why: On busy days builders hold agent places while they wait for the test line, so other items cannot start even though those places sit idle (seen: 4 agent places held, 6 items waiting for tests, waits up to 3 hours).
